'''Sentinel Outpost''' was a military base established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Corellian Security Force]] at the northern end of the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle for the Black Hole|battle for the area]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic base in the Black Hole Daily Area, Sentinel Outpost was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
